title: Tungsten 内存布局：行式 JVM 对象 vs 紧凑二进制 + 列裁剪
code:
OBJ_HEADER, REF, FIXED, ARRAY_HEADER, CHAR = 16, 8, 8, 16, 2

SCHEMA = [("id", "long", 0), ("name", "string", 12), ("dept", "string", 8),
          ("salary", "double", 0), ("city", "string", 10)]
ROWS = 1000000


def align8(x):
    return (x + 7) // 8 * 8


def jvm_field_bytes(t, length):
    if t == "string":
        return OBJ_HEADER + ARRAY_HEADER + CHAR * length   # String 对象 + char[] 对象
    return OBJ_HEADER + FIXED                              # 装箱 Long/Double 对象


def jvm_row_bytes(schema):
    row_obj = OBJ_HEADER + REF * len(schema)               # GenericRow 对象 + 引用数组
    return row_obj + sum(jvm_field_bytes(t, l) for _, t, l in schema)


def unsafe_row_bytes(schema):
    n = len(schema)
    bitmap = 8 * ((n + 63) // 64)                          # null 位图
    fixed = 8 * n                                          # 定长区：每字段 8 字节
    var = sum(align8(CHAR * l) for _, t, l in schema if t == "string")
    return bitmap + fixed + var


full_pruned = [f for f in SCHEMA if f[0] in ("dept", "salary")]

jvm = jvm_row_bytes(SCHEMA)
tg_full = unsafe_row_bytes(SCHEMA)
tg_pruned = unsafe_row_bytes(full_pruned)

print("Schema: " + str([(n, t, l) for n, t, l in SCHEMA]))
print("")
print("每行字节数:")
print("  行式（JVM 对象 + 装箱）            = " + str(jvm))
print("  Tungsten UnsafeRow（全部 5 列）    = " + str(tg_full))
print("  Tungsten UnsafeRow（裁剪为 dept,salary） = " + str(tg_pruned))
print("")
print("读取 " + str(ROWS) + " 行的总字节数:")
print("  行式（JVM 对象 + 装箱）            = " + str(jvm * ROWS))
print("  Tungsten UnsafeRow（全部 5 列）    = " + str(tg_full * ROWS))
print("  Tungsten UnsafeRow（裁剪后 2 列）  = " + str(tg_pruned * ROWS))
print("")

print("行式 / Tungsten 全列 = " + str(round(jvm / tg_full, 2)))
print("行式 / Tungsten 裁剪后 = " + str(round(jvm / tg_pruned, 2)))
print("判据 紧凑布局省字节（全列）: " + str(tg_full < jvm))
print("判据 列裁剪进一步省字节: " + str(tg_pruned < tg_full))
print("判据 行式相对裁剪后省字节倍数 > 5: " + str(round(jvm / tg_pruned, 2) > 5))
print("判据 GC 压力下降（对象数 每行 " + str(len(SCHEMA)) + " -> 0）: " + str(len(SCHEMA) > 0))
